question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**In the doldrums**

options.text: In a state of depression or inactivity

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e., "In a state of depression or inactivity".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The phrase **"In the doldrums"** means being in a state of depression or inactivity, where things seem stagnant and unprogressive. (निराशा या निष्क्रियता की स्थिति में होना)

 

 
• **Example:** After the company lost its biggest client, it has been in the doldrums for months, struggling to recover.

 

 

 
• **Explanation of the phrase:** The term "doldrums" originates from maritime terminology, referring to parts of the ocean near the equator known for calm winds, where ships would often get stuck. Figuratively, it describes a state of stagnation or low energy. (समुद्र की स्थिति को दर्शाने वाले शब्द से लिया गया है, जहां जहाज रुक जाते थे, और इसे अब स्थिरता या कम ऊर्जा की स्थिति के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाता है।)

 

 
• **Example:** John felt in the doldrums after failing his exams, but his friends motivated him to try again.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e., "In a state of depression or inactivity".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__

 
• **Option 1: Sailing in high winds** (तेज हवाओं में नौकायन): Refers to navigating a boat in strong winds, often requiring skill and effort.

 

 
• **Example:** The sailors were sailing in high winds to reach the shore before the storm hit.

 

 
• **Option 3: On the verge of success** (सफलता के कगार पर): Close to achieving success or accomplishing a goal.

 

 
• **Example:** After years of hard work, she was finally on the verge of success in her career.

 

 
• **Option 4: Working with great energy** (बहुत ऊर्जा के साथ काम करना): Describes someone putting in a lot of effort and enthusiasm into their tasks.

 

 
• **Example:** The team was working with great energy to meet the project deadline.
